The cumulative distribution function is P(X≤x)=1−e^(−λx) and the probability density is f(x)=λe^(−λx) for x≥0. map.二者描述同一过程的两面：若单位时间内事件发生次数服从泊松分布（参数 λ），则两次: They are two faces of the same process: if the number of events per unit time follows a Poisson distribution with parameter λ, then the gaps between events follow an exponential distribution with the same λ.
